question: Does minimizing the unchanged original one-epoch RMS score select lower restored-checkpoint validation error than minimizing validation CE from the same probe state?
status: Exploratory development on reused MNIST training/validation examples. Fresh seeds and a freeze before execution do not make this independent held-out-data confirmation or confirmatory evidence. Unthresholded metric/lifecycle comparison, not the production 100-eligible-to-10 HPO algorithm; no theory-repair claim.

data.source: cached MNIST npz, official-training x_train/y_train arrays only; never read official-test arrays

architecture.implementation: existing get_mnist_model, same as completed eight-configuration panel

configs.ordering: product(LR,WD), LR outer, IDs0..7; no ranges changed after prior results

pairing: Reset Keras seed before each phase model. Verify identical initial weights within block/phase across all8configs. Verify shared epoch shuffle prefixes within block/phase. Seeds do not depend on rank, method, configID or attempted order.

probe.optimizer: existing Adam with constant per-configLR, no cosine schedule; configured WD retained
probe.subset: All1500 training examples, randomized into a shared per-block permutation; same membership, reordered measurement batches
probe.measurement_order: fixed subset permutation, consecutive64 batches with final28; this differs from canonical data order and is recorded exactly
probe.validation: same current probe model, common375 validation examples, actual Keras compiled CE baseline

final_fit.initialization: fresh model; independent final-phase seed, no probe weights or optimizer state reused
final_fit.optimizer: same Adam with cosine decay over2400steps, maximum100epochs,24batches/epoch
final_fit.shuffle: canonical training order permuted independently each epoch with default_rng(final_shuffle_seed); paired prefixes across configs

early_stopping.implementation: actual installed keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping with monitor=val_loss,patience25,restore_best_weightsTrue; constructor defaults min_delta0,baselineNone,start_from_epoch0,modeauto
early_stopping.hooks: set_model; on_train_begin; on_epoch_end(zero-based epoch, actual Keras validation loss); on_train_end restores minimum monitored-loss weights
early_stopping.monitor: Reset model metrics before validation; model.test_on_batch all375 validation examples in consecutive64 batches(last55). Installed TF test_step accumulates compiled logits-aware CE with batch-size weighting. Stable float64 CE is separately logged and never used for stopping.
early_stopping.semantics_limit: Manual deterministic paired training permutations instead of model.fit internal shuffle. Actual callback and compiled validation-monitor semantics retained; no assertion of bitwise equivalence to a separately randomized model.fit run.

final_fit.saved_optimizer_note: Final weights are restored, but optimizer iteration/moments retain terminal-fit state as in the existing production callback. Do not claim optimizer restoration to best epoch.

metrics.original: Original float32RMS arithmetic max finite batch score RMS(p)*RMS(h)/RMS(W); retain all raw components. Match get_convexity fallback to positive infinity if no positive finite maximum exists. Store JSONnull plus explicit status for nonfinite values, no hidden clipping.
metrics.baseline: actual Keras validation CE at one-epoch probe
metrics.legacy_eligibility: record finite score>0.1 but do not filter, resample, reverse score direction or modify formula
metrics.primary_target: 1 - restored-checkpoint validation accuracy from actual model class predictions
metrics.secondary_target: actual Keras validation CE at the restored checkpoint
metrics.stable_ce_diagnostic: float64 reconstructed-logit CE, separate from actual Keras monitored CE. Reuse frozen classification helper with absolute probability reconstruction tolerance1e-5.
metrics.restored_verification: Retain restored-checkpoint weights/modelSHA and metrics; independent verification can reload every checkpoint. No official-test outcomes.

analysis.population: all8 configs within each seed block separately; no pooled inferential claim
analysis.correlation: Spearman fixed probe score vs each restored target; positive rho favors minimization; undefined constant ranks recordednull
analysis.selection: top1 per score per block; ties lowerconfigID, unchanged regardless oftarget
analysis.regret: selected target minus minimum target among all8 candidates in block
analysis.ties: retain score-minimum and target-minimum tie counts; discrete validation accuracy ties do not establishequivalence
analysis.gate: all16probes and16finalfits must complete; if any original score has infinity-fallback status, mark comparisonincomplete and do not compute finite-subset aggregates
analysis.learning_rate_associations: Within each seed block, report Spearman LR versus each probe score and each restored target. Separately report the prespecified sensitivity averaging both WD candidates at each LR: four LR-mean score/target pairs, descriptive only. No correlation inference within two-point WD strata.

resources.bound_semantics: check before phases and each epoch; one active epoch/restoration/checkpointIO may extend beyond bound; stop newepochs cleanly
resources.maximum_compute: 16one-epochprobes plus16finalfits(max100epochs),1616epochs/38784optimizersteps if all reachmax; actual stopping mayreduce

failure_accounting: Every fixed candidate/phase remains in manifest; retain failures, missing phases and partial checkpoints, do not refill. Continue remaining fixed phases after logged recoverable failures while budgetremains. No aggregate complete-panel claim if phase or metric validity is incomplete.
artifacts: Unique directory, exact source/data/package/environmentprovenance, phase seedmanifest, explicit probe subsetorder.npy, per-epoch shufflehashes/optimizersteps/Keras monitor/stableCE, probe+restoredfinal checkpoints/hashes, all events and summary. Timeout finalfit retains last weights before restoration plus partialrestored weights, both selectionineligible.
prior_evidence: Completed longpanel changed targetranking; preserve all earlierresults. New panel changes probe/final lifecycle, seeds and operationaltarget prospectively. It cannot establish full-network flatness, repair the invalid local lowerbound or prove broadHPOefficacy.
revision_note: Before execution: add descriptive learning-rate associations/four-LR-mean sensitivity, imported-clone verification, finite-weight guard and primary-error-preserving checkpoint failures. Scientific phases, metric formulas, seeds and targets otherwise unchanged.
runtime_integrity: Require imported image.src.util.__file__ to resolve to the frozen clone source, record the path; hash all model weights and require finite weights after each epoch.
